2608.23124.title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space
2608.23124.paper_summary: Personalized text generation for authors and literary writing is essential for applications such as adaptive writing assistants, creative support tools, and computational literary analysis. However, existing approaches to author modeling and personalization often represent writing behavior as independent labels, requiring large-scale corpus collection or fine-tuning for each author or stylistic category. Such formulations are costly, difficult to interpret, and poorly suited for generalizing across authors. Inspired by the Big Five model's dimensional view of personality, we propose LiteraryBigFive, a framework that reframes authorial writing characteristics as coordinates within a unified and interpretable space. In this space, we derive each interpretable axis (e.g., Classicism, Emotionality) from activation-space contrasts between author-written and neutral passages, yielding distinct stylistic dimensions that allow texts or authors to be positioned within a five-dimensional system. Beyond localizing different authors, we further introduce an interpretable steering mechanism, which adaptively guides text generation toward target coordinates to perform author-personalized writing. Experimental results show that LiteraryBigFive improves authorial expressiveness while preserving semantic fidelity. The derived author per-axis scores strongly correlate with real-world literary consensus, offering transparent and interpretable explanations of author-specific generation behavior: https://github.com/Znull-1220/LiteraryBigFive.
2608.23124.paper_summary_zh: 個性化文本生成對於作者和文學寫作至關重要，應用於自適應寫作助手、創意支持工具和計算文學分析等領域。 然而，現有的作者建模和個性化方法通常將寫作行為表示為獨立的標籤，這需要大規模的語料庫收集或對每位作者或風格類別進行微調。 這樣的表述成本高昂、難以解釋，且不適合在不同作者之間進行泛化。 我們受到五大人格模型的啟發，提出了LiteraryBigFive，一個將作者寫作特徵重新框架為統一且可解釋空間中的坐標的框架。 在這個空間中，我們從作者寫作和中性段落之間的激活空間對比中推導出每個可解釋的軸（例如，古典主義、情感性），產生出明確的風格維度，允許文本或作者在五維系統中被定位。 除了定位不同的作者外，我們進一步引入了一個可解釋的引導機制，該機制自適應地引導文本生成朝向目標坐標，以執行作者個性化寫作。 實驗結果顯示，LiteraryBigFive在保留語義真實性的同時提高了作者的表達能力。 推導出的每個軸的作者分數與現實世界的文學共識強烈相關，提供了對作者特定生成行為的透明和可解釋的解釋： https://github.com/Znull-1220/LiteraryBigFive。
